summary: We are seeking an experienced AI Developer to design, develop, and deploy intelligent applications that leverage Machine Learning, Conversational AI, and custom datasets.
responsibilities: Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured datasets.
Perform feature engineering and exploratory data analysis for model readiness.
Design and implement machine learning models for NLP, intent recognition, and predictive analytics.
Fine-tune LLMs or domain-specific models for enterprise use cases.
Build MCP-based applications for model orchestration and lifecycle management.
Develop chatbots and interactive apps to handle business queries on custom datasets.
Integrate AI services with enterprise platforms (e.g., Slack, Teams, internal portals).
Connect AI components with APIs, databases, and cloud services.
Ensure seamless integration with existing bot services and monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog).
Optimize models for accuracy, latency, and scalability.
Implement automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for AI applications.
required_skills: Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and NLP frameworks.
Experience with MCP platforms, API development, and cloud environments (AWS/Azure).
Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, CI/CD, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
Knowledge of data visualization, SQL, and JSON-based integrations.
Understanding of enterprise security and compliance standards.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience in building chatbots for Slack/Teams or similar platforms.
Exposure to LLM fine-tuning and prompt engineering.
Background in financial services or analytics-driven environments.
